instructions: Sign in to Google Drive for Desktop in your browser using your Google Account ({{PRIMARY_EMAIL}}).
Confirm that the Google Drive streaming virtual drive is mounted at {{STREAM_MOUNT}} ({{STREAM_VERIFY_FOLDER}}).
Open Google Drive Preferences -> 'Folders from your computer' -> click 'Add folder', select 'Sync with Google Drive', and add each local sync directory: {{SYNC_DIRS_SUMMARY}}.

In Google Drive under Computers (or via '{{STREAM_MOUNT}}\Other computers\{{SOURCE_COMPUTER_NAME}}'), {{MIGRATION_MODE}} the contents of each synced folder from the previous computer '{{SOURCE_COMPUTER_NAME}}' (profile '{{PROFILE_NAME}}') into the newly created computer's folders and wait for initial sync to finish.
